objective: Increase natural retail fruit-powerup overlap by preserving active type-0 chain balls until an active fruit enters the strict native 108-pixel TreasurePoint radius, while retaining ordinary Win32 input and zero process-memory writes.

preservation_contract.trigger_rule: Retain the qualified c174 strict-radius trigger rule unchanged whenever an active uncollected fruit and a qualifying bomb run are available.
preservation_contract.preserve_rule: When at least one active bomb exists but no qualified trigger can execute, remove every candidate run containing an active bomb from current- and next-chamber targeting.
preservation_contract.safe_alternative_rule: Apply the pre-existing complete-match and build-pair ordering exactly to the remaining bomb-free current and next rows.
preservation_contract.discard_rule: If no bomb-free current or next row exists, fire the current chamber toward the first deterministic in-canvas perimeter point whose ray has no active-chain collision and, while fruit is active, remains at least 60 pixels from the rendered fruit centre.
preservation_contract.wait_rule: If no safe discard ray exists, issue no input for that decision and reevaluate on the next normal poll.
preservation_contract.bomb_expiration_or_natural_chain_loss: No process-memory intervention is permitted; retail movement, expiry and terminal outcome remain natural.

required_tests: a bomb-free same-colour row is selected instead of a bomb-bearing row
the next chamber is used when it is the only bomb-free match
a clear perimeter discard cycles an otherwise forced bomb shot
an active fruit excludes discard rays passing within the 60-pixel safety radius
the strict-radius trigger still outranks preservation
no active bomb preserves the qualified c174 recommendation
ignore and collect policy tests remain unchanged
